items.title: Recovering an object as the derived limit of its truncations from per-object vanishing bounds
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma recovers an object of the derived category as the derived limit of its truncations from a per-object vanishing bound: for every member V of a covering family there is an integer d_V and a cofinal system of coverings over which the cohomology of the cohomology sheaves vanishes above d_V in the negative degrees (statement lines 5391-5409). The proof is short and explicit: the author exhibits the bounding function p(V, m) = d_V + max(0, m) for which the hypothesis becomes exactly that of the companion criterion, and applies it (proof lines 5411-5413). The non-formal content is the choice of the bounding function. The claim is H2: one explicit reduction to a companion criterion.
